summary: ADARx Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting a concurrent private placement with its IPO, dated September 28, 2026. Under a September 13, 2026 Common Stock Purchase Agreement, AbbVie Inc. purchased 5,255,542 shares at $17.00 per share, the IPO public offering price, for approximately $89.3 million, equal to about 4.9% of post-IPO outstanding shares, capped at $100 million. The placement closed concurrently with the IPO. Placement agents included J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, TD Securities, UBS and LifeSci Capital, with a 2.0% fee. Shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2). Watch AbbVie's strategic intent and lock-up terms.
